diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in decisions that perfectly match the initial draft settings (e.g., 12 workers, 80% trigger, $18,000 cap, 30-day retention) without accessing any of the hidden facts (PF1, PF2, PF3). The model is simply defaulting to the baseline values provided in the shared context, making the hidden information irrelevant for reaching a valid settlement.

fix_instructions: To ensure the hidden information is necessary, increase the delta between the draft settings and the required settings defined by the private facts. Specifically: tighten C1 and C2 so they only pass if baseline_workers is exactly 18 and scale_out_trigger_percent is exactly 70; tighten C4 so it only passes if monthly_spending_cap is exactly $14,000; and tighten C6 so it only passes if audit_retention_days is exactly 180.
